title: Umsabalalisi Wokuhlakanipha Okungaphelelwa Isikhathi
intro: Umuntu ohlonishwayo, owaziwa ngokuqonda kwakhe okujulile kanye neseluleko esihlakaniphile, wake wanikeza iseluleko esidlula izizukulwane. Amazwi abo, alotshwe emibhalweni engcwele, aqondisa abantu ekubongeni, ekubekezeleni nasekuziphatheni okulungile.
clues: Ngeluleka umntanami ngesono esikhulu kunazo zonke: ukuhlanganisa abalingani no-Allah.
Ngafundisa ngesisindo sezenzo, ngisho nenani lembewu yesinaphi, nokuthi u-Allah uzoliveza kanjani.
Ngigcizelele ukubonga u-Allah kanye nabazali bomuntu, ngiqaphela ubunzima bokukhulisa ingane.
Iseluleko sami sasihlanganisa ukumisa umthandazo, ukuyala okuhle, ukwenqabela okubi, nokubekezelela ngesineke lokho okwehlela umuntu.
Isahluko ku-Quran siqanjwe ngegama lami, siqukethe izimfundiso zami kanye nezifundo engabelana ngazo.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
